design: Frozen H275 programs plus exact E(mu) constant computed once from native-minus-original-compiler polynomial at frozen discovery mean. Replaces full final-layer MLP write; retain downstream final RMS/lm_head/softcap. No conditional native intact baseline; no refit or test calibration. Constant-only and common mean-linear/within-core controls. Fresh128 docs exclude1856 prior document hashes. Float32 forward, float64 KL.

gates.intact_actual: actual mean CE increase<=.02 nats AND top1 agreement>=.98
gates.repair_actual: actual KL reduction versus compiled>=80% AND intact_actual
gates.repair_mixture: mixture KL reduction versus compiled>=80% AND intact_mixture

scope: Same corpus/model, new documents for continuation, not training/global holdout. No semantic ontology claim. Residual constant is polynomial value at mean, not fitted mean residual.
